pinoutBasis: Previously reviewed local TI datasheets, TI land-pattern captures and library manifest; identity pin-number mapping is crosschecked against actual PAD_NET primitive IDs and latest schematic. No new internet research needed.

R0402.basis: existing checkpoint footprint; exact bodies except new META identity

C0402.basis: existing checkpoint footprint; exact bodies except new META identity

C0603.basis: existing checkpoint footprint; exact bodies except new META identity

C0805.basis: existing checkpoint footprint; exact bodies except new META identity

DBV5.basis: TI official example land pattern, top view, native footprint Y-up

DBZ3.basis: TI official example land pattern, top view, native footprint Y-up

limitations: Pad geometry and pin mapping only, not placement/routing or fabrication approval. New parts remain parked outside board until root placement work.
Passive0402/0603/0805 lands are preserved project-local clones, not manufacturer-specific passive land approval.
Intrinsic master-pad clearance bounds do not assess clearances to neighboring board copper or rule-inherited solder/paste masks.
Full1136-pin PCB/SCH contract, preserved project/library scope and placement are separately audited by parent/root.
